title: Soil N transformation rates protocol
author: Ochoa Esteban, Victoria
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare soil at target moisture
steps.instruction: Adjust fresh soil to 80 % of its water holding capacity (WHC) by adding water and mixing thoroughly.

steps.title: Take baseline subsample
steps.instruction: Weigh an aliquot of the prepared soil into a tube for the initial (pre‑incubation) extraction.

steps.title: Extract baseline nitrogen
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 M K2SO4 or 1 M KCl to the tube at a 1 : 10 soil‑to‑solution ratio, mix, centrifuge, and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Analyze baseline nitrogen forms
steps.instruction: Determine total extractable nitrogen (TAN), ammonium (NH4⁺‑N), nitrate (NO3⁻‑N) and dissolved organic nitrogen (DON) in the extract using the described colorimetric methods.

steps.title: Incubate soil sample
steps.instruction: Place the remaining soil in a sealed container, keep at 30 °C and 80 % WHC for 14 days.

steps.title: Extract post‑incubation nitrogen
steps.instruction: After 14 days, repeat the extraction with the same 0.5 M K2SO4 or 1 M KCl solution at a 1 : 10 ratio, mix, centrifuge, and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Analyze post‑incubation nitrogen
steps.instruction: Perform the same colorimetric analyses for TAN, NH4⁺‑N, NO3⁻‑N and DON on the post‑incubation extract.

steps.title: Calculate net N transformation rates
steps.instruction: Using linear calibration curves from standards, calculate concentrations (mg N kg⁻¹ soil) for each N form and express net changes as mg N kg⁻¹ soil day⁻¹ (divide by 14 days).
